upstream.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.

classification.analysis: HyperFrames is an open-source TypeScript/Node framework that turns HTML, CSS, GSAP/Lottie/Three.js animations, and media into deterministic MP4 video via a CLI, and is explicitly designed for AI coding agents to drive through a large set of installable skills. It ships 20 agent skills (a `/hyperframes` router plus creation workflows for product-launch videos, faceless explainers, PR-to-video changelogs, captions, motion graphics, slideshows, etc.) that work with Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and Codex, plus local, cloud (HeyGen), and AWS Lambda rendering. It targets developers and agent-driven content pipelines who want programmatic, reproducible video generation instead of a timeline-based video editor like Remotion.

use_cases.title: Generate a product launch or marketing video from a website URL with an AI agent
Turn a GitHub pull request into a changelog explainer video
Render deterministic MP4 video from HTML/CSS animations via CLI
Port an existing Remotion React composition to HyperFrames HTML
